typography.rules: Preserve established design system. Ensure Playfair Display is used for all major headings. Avoid generic center-aligned layouts. Do not recommend unrelated typography rebrand.

colors.rules: Deep navy, refined blue, white, off-white palette. Do not use dark colors as gradients. Maintain strict adherence to this palette to ensure a professional, credible advisory-firm feel.

visual enhancers.effects: Crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + shadows. No detached rectangular or airbrushed/faded images.

grids.strategy: Use asymmetric layouts and clear grid structures to establish hierarchy, rather than standard centered columns.

layouts.strategy: Mobile-first responsive. Generous whitespace to avoid cluttered BPO feel. Recompose hero as one integrated photographic section without feathered edges. Clear paths for accounting/CPA firms and SMBs.

motion.rules: Hover states (all interactive elements), micro-animations for interactions. Smooth transitions but avoid universal transition `all`. Disable/reduce animations for users who prefer reduced motion.

accessibility.rules: Ensure proper contrast ratios for text. Add `data-testid` to all interactive and key informational elements. Use semantic HTML.

media.rules: Use the provided image URL for an integrated hero section. Remove the feathered/faded edge CSS effect. Do not use generic placeholders.

3d libraries.rules: None required for this professional B2B marketing site.

hero_integrated_photo.description: Professional accounting team meeting, meant to be used as an integrated, edge-to-edge section or full bleed background for the hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refine the homepage implementing the blueprint from /app/homepage_reference_plan.md. Recompose the hero as an integrated photographic section without the faded/airbrushed edges (remove .hero-photo masks). Retain existing logo with trademark, color palette, navigation, and services. Emphasize distinct paths for CPA/Accounting firms and SMBs. Do NOT add new services, testimonials, or fake stats.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters. You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). You MUST NOT center align the app container. Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary. Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
